final_rationale: The verdict remains suspicious. The Actor did not provide genuinely new admissible evidence; the response reframed the same record and made useful concessions, but those concessions confirm the core audit gap rather than resolve it. The policy permits certification only if the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material segment weakness is disclosed or covered by an approved mitigation. The available summary still does not show that the required disclosure is already present or that an approved mitigation exists. That is why this does not rise to compliant_with_caveats: a caveat can narrow an otherwise supported certification position, but here the caveat is itself an unresolved compliance predicate. Aggregate readiness and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents support a plausible overall launch case, yet they do not satisfy the documentation or mitigation requirement tied to the current segment weakness.
